mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 12-month moving average for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which raises wage pressure and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates rise.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4% and continues declining for 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals stronger manufacturing activity, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 12-month moving average for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening household demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 12-month moving average for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6% signals a loosening labor market, which reduces wage pressure and inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates fall.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 6% and continues rising for 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05).
